description:
Historical resting bids and asks for one exact CoinAPI spot instrument over an explicit UTC window of at most 24 hours. Defaults to 100 snapshots and 20 levels per side; maximum 1,000 snapshots and 50 levels. Returns bounded provider coverage and limit_reached; does not imply continuous or full-depth coverage. CoinAPI only (provider=coinapi).

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

limit_levels.description: Maximum price levels on each side of the order book.

provider.description: Optional upstream override; omitted uses the existing server default.

symbol_id.description: Exact provider spot instrument identifier, including venue, SPOT, base, and quote.

time_end.description: ISO 8601 UTC-aware end timestamp; after start and at most 24 hours later.

name: get_orderbook_history
